verdict.rationale: The evidence shows privacy controls over the error data customers send to Raygun: scrubbing sensitive fields before transmission and a 'Disable IP address storage' flag. It never documents a way for the Raygun user to opt out of Raygun's own telemetry or usage tracking, whether in the dashboard, SDKs or MCP server. These data-scrubbing controls address a different concern, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.
